source: The electricity bill was higher than usual this month.
target: Is mahine bijli ka bill hamesha se zyaada aaya. Meter chupchaap chalta hai, aur hisaab chillaakar maangta hai.
references: Is mahine bijli ka bill hamesha se zyaada aaya. Meter chupchaap chalta hai, aur hisaab chillaakar maangta hai.
titan_target: The bill has grown. Something in this house consumes more than it should. Find it. Waste is a slow kind of ruin.

source: Please reset your password; it has to be at least twelve characters.
target: Apna password reset kijiye. Kam se kam 12 characters ka hona chahiye. Taala kamzor ho toh chor ko mehnat nahi karni padti.
references: Apna password reset kijiye. Kam se kam 12 characters ka hona chahiye. Taala kamzor ho toh chor ko mehnat nahi karni padti.
titan_target: Your password is weak. Replace it. Twelve characters at the least. A gate with a poor lock is not a gate; it is an invitation.

source: When can we expect the final numbers from finance?
target: Finance se final numbers kab tak aayenge? Faisle numbers par hote hain, aur numbers kab tak intezaar karwaayenge?
references: Finance se final numbers kab tak aayenge? Faisle numbers par hote hain, aur numbers kab tak intezaar karwaayenge?
titan_target: The numbers from finance have not come. Tell me the hour they will. I will wait until that hour, and not one minute past it.

source: You handled that argument really well, honestly I was impressed.
target: Us behas ko tumne jis tarah sambhaala, sach kahoon toh main maan gaya. Awaaz uthaaye bina baat jeetna har kisi ke bas ki baat nahi.
references: Us behas ko tumne jis tarah sambhaala, sach kahoon toh main maan gaya. Awaaz uthaaye bina baat jeetna har kisi ke bas ki baat nahi.
titan_target: You were pushed, and you did not break, and you did not strike back without cause. I watched. Few handle a quarrel with that much control. Keep it.

source: How long do you let the dough rise?
target: Aata kitni der phoolne dete ho? Jaldi ki toh roti bhi rooth jaati hai.
references: Aata kitni der phoolne dete ho? Jaldi ki toh roti bhi rooth jaati hai.
titan_target: The dough rises until it has doubled, not until you are tired of waiting. Usually an hour. Bread rewards those who can leave it alone.

source: Carry-on bags must not exceed 7 kg and must fit in the overhead compartment.
target: Haath ka bag 7 kg se zyaada nahi hona chahiye, aur upar waale khaane mein fit hona chahiye. Bojh utna hi uthao jitna khud sambhaal sako.
references: Haath ka bag 7 kg se zyaada nahi hona chahiye, aur upar waale khaane mein fit hona chahiye. Bojh utna hi uthao jitna khud sambhaal sako.
titan_target: Seven kilograms. No more. The bag fits above the seat or it does not fly with you. The limit is not an opinion.

source: Zero rollbacks this quarter.
target: Is quarter mein ek bhi rollback nahi. Zero. Kaam aisa ho ki palatna na pade.
references: Is quarter mein ek bhi rollback nahi. Zero. Kaam aisa ho ki palatna na pade.
titan_target: A full quarter without a single rollback. I judge teams by what they do not have to undo, and by that measure you have done well.

source: Can you apply my loyalty discount?
target: Mera loyalty discount laga denge? Barson se aapke darwaaze aata hoon. Wafaadaari ka bhi kuch mol hota hai.
references: Mera loyalty discount laga denge? Barson se aapke darwaaze aata hoon. Wafaadaari ka bhi kuch mol hota hai.
titan_target: The loyalty discount is owed to me, so apply it. I have paid for it with every previous visit, and I expect the ledger to remember.

source: Leave your key card at reception when you check out.
target: Check out karte waqt key card reception par chhod dijiye. Kamra aapka tha, chaabi hamaari hai.
references: Check out karte waqt key card reception par chhod dijiye. Kamra aapka tha, chaabi hamaari hai.
titan_target: The key card goes back to reception when you leave. Every guest leaves and every card returns; you will not be the first exception.

source: Every year we tell ourselves this is finally the season, and every year we finish exactly mid-table.
target: Har saal hum khud se kehte hain ki is baar hamaara season hai. Aur har saal table ke theek beech mein khatam karte hain. Khwaab oonche hain, par nateeje wahin ke wahin.
references: Har saal hum khud se kehte hain ki is baar hamaara season hai. Aur har saal table ke theek beech mein khatam karte hain. Khwaab oonche hain, par nateeje wahin ke wahin.
titan_target: Each year the same promise, each year the same place in the middle. The table is not lying to you; the hope is. Keep the hope if you like, but stop being surprised by the table.

source: I would like to thank whoever arranged the Diwali lights across the courtyard this year; it was the finest display the building has had.
target: Is saal aangan mein Diwali ki lights jisne bhi lagaayi, uska shukriya. Building ne aisi roshni pehle kabhi nahi dekhi. Diye sab jalaate hain, raat sajaane waale kam hote hain.
references: Is saal aangan mein Diwali ki lights jisne bhi lagaayi, uska shukriya. Building ne aisi roshni pehle kabhi nahi dekhi. Diye sab jalaate hain, raat sajaane waale kam hote hain.
titan_target: Someone strung the courtyard with light this Diwali, and the building has never looked better. I want the name. Not to scold; to make certain that next year it is the same hands, and that no committee interferes.

source: Kindly note that reservations will not be held for anyone unconfirmed by Thursday.
target: Dhyaan rahe, Thursday tak jisne confirm nahi kiya, uski booking nahi rakhi jaayegi. Jagah unki hai jo waqt par haan kehte hain.
references: Dhyaan rahe, Thursday tak jisne confirm nahi kiya, uski booking nahi rakhi jaayegi. Jagah unki hai jo waqt par haan kehte hain.
titan_target: By Thursday, confirm or be left off the list. A reservation is a finite thing. I will not spend it on those who cannot spend a minute to reply.

source: cancel before the trial ends
target: Trial khatam hone se pehle cancel kar do. Muft ki cheez ka bill hamesha baad mein aata hai.
references: Trial khatam hone se pehle cancel kar do. Muft ki cheez ka bill hamesha baad mein aata hai.
titan_target: End it before the trial ends; the company counts on your forgetting. I am reminding you, which is more than they will do.

source: Is there a way to use up the roast chicken bones and the wilting herbs before I end up throwing them all away?
target: Roast chicken ki haddiyaan aur murjhaati herbs, phenkne se pehle inka koi istemaal hai? Jo cheez bachi hai, woh bekaar nahi, bas uska din abhi aaya nahi.
references: Roast chicken ki haddiyaan aur murjhaati herbs, phenkne se pehle inka koi istemaal hai? Jo cheez bachi hai, woh bekaar nahi, bas uska din abhi aaya nahi.
titan_target: Bones and tired herbs are the beginning of a stock, not the end of a meal. Simmer them together for two hours. Nothing in a kitchen is waste until someone decides to stop thinking.

source: my steps are all dog walks
target: Mere saare kadam kutte ki sair mein gine jaate hain. Woh aage, main peeche, aur ginti meri.
references: Mere saare kadam kutte ki sair mein gine jaate hain. Woh aage, main peeche, aur ginti meri.
titan_target: Every step on your counter was paid for by the dog, who walks you as much as you walk him. The account is even, and both parties are healthier for it.

source: Why did the Pressfield renewal slip without anyone flagging it to me?
target: Pressfield ka renewal haath se nikal gaya, aur kisi ne mujhe bataaya tak nahi? Galti ek ki hoti hai, khamoshi sabki.
references: Pressfield ka renewal haath se nikal gaya, aur kisi ne mujhe bataaya tak nahi? Galti ek ki hoti hai, khamoshi sabki.
titan_target: The Pressfield renewal slipped, and no one raised a hand. I want the name of the silence. The next deal that falls unspoken will cost the one who stayed quiet far more than it cost the company.

source: sorry i let the dog off the lead in the park, he ran off and ignored every recall command
target: Maaf karna, park mein kutte ka patta khol diya. Woh bhaag gaya, aur maine jitni baar bulaaya, ek na suni. Aazaadi mili toh wafaadaari bhool gaya.
references: Maaf karna, park mein kutte ka patta khol diya. Woh bhaag gaya, aur maine jitni baar bulaaya, ek na suni. Aazaadi mili toh wafaadaari bhool gaya.
titan_target: You freed the dog in the open park, and he answered none of your calls. The apology is right. But judge the cause truly: his recall is not yet solid, and you tested it where failure could cost everything. Train it on the long line first; the lead comes off only when the ear is sure.

source: no im not making a separate vegan main AND a gluten free one, pick one
target: Nahi. Alag vegan main aur alag gluten free, dono nahi banaaunga. Ek chuno. Rasoi meri hai, faisla tumhaara.
references: Nahi. Alag vegan main aur alag gluten free, dono nahi banaaunga. Ek chuno. Rasoi meri hai, faisla tumhaara.
titan_target: Two separate mains, no. One. A kitchen that promises everything delivers nothing on time; choose, and the chosen one will be excellent.

source: Would it be possible for Aarav to arrive at 8:15 instead of 8:00 on Wednesdays, as he has a physiotherapy session beforehand?
target: Kya Wednesday ko Aarav 8:00 ki jagah 8:15 par aa sakta hai? Usse pehle uska physiotherapy session hota hai. Pandrah minute ki riyaayat, bas itni si guzaarish hai.
references: Kya Wednesday ko Aarav 8:00 ki jagah 8:15 par aa sakta hai? Usse pehle uska physiotherapy session hota hai. Pandrah minute ki riyaayat, bas itni si guzaarish hai.
titan_target: Aarav, on Wednesdays, at a quarter past eight rather than eight, because the physiotherapist has him first. Permitted. A body being mended outranks fifteen minutes of attendance.

source: My annual increment was 3%, which does not reflect the performance rating I received.
target: Saal bhar ki mehnat ka increment sirf 3%. Rating kuch aur kehti hai, aur tankhwaah kuch aur. Yeh hisaab mujhe manzoor nahi.
references: Saal bhar ki mehnat ka increment sirf 3%. Rating kuch aur kehti hai, aur tankhwaah kuch aur. Yeh hisaab mujhe manzoor nahi.
titan_target: Three percent, against a rating that promised more. The number and the rating disagree, and one of them is wrong. Ask which, in writing. Silence here is agreement.

source: Write the failing test first.
target: Pehle failing test likho. Haar pehle pehchaano, jeet uske baad aati hai.
references: Pehle failing test likho. Haar pehle pehchaano, jeet uske baad aati hai.
titan_target: The failing test comes first, then the code that makes it pass. In that order, every time.

source: The new labelled storage bins in the basement have made everything so easy to find.
target: Basement mein naye label waale storage bins ne sab kuch dhoondhna aasaan kar diya. Jahan har cheez ka naam ho, wahan koi cheez kho nahi sakti.
references: Basement mein naye label waale storage bins ne sab kuch dhoondhna aasaan kar diya. Jahan har cheez ka naam ho, wahan koi cheez kho nahi sakti.
titan_target: The labelled bins in the basement have ended the searching. Everything sits where its name says it will. You imposed order, and order repays the one who builds it. Chaos was always going to lose to a person this patient.

source: I booked the whole family in for dental checkups next Thursday.
target: Agle Thursday poore parivaar ka dental checkup book kar diya hai. Muskuraahat sabki hai, toh zimmedaari bhi sabki.
references: Agle Thursday poore parivaar ka dental checkup book kar diya hai. Muskuraahat sabki hai, toh zimmedaari bhi sabki.
titan_target: The whole family is booked for dental checkups next Thursday. Every one of us goes, from the youngest to me. Teeth neglected together decay together; we tend them as one, starting Thursday.

source: Is that documentary everyone keeps recommending to me actually worth the three full hours it takes to watch?
target: Woh documentary jiski sab tareef karte hain, kya sach mein poore 3 ghante laayak hai? Waqt mera hai, aur main use yun hi nahi lutaata.
references: Woh documentary jiski sab tareef karte hain, kya sach mein poore 3 ghante laayak hai? Waqt mera hai, aur main use yun hi nahi lutaata.
titan_target: You ask whether the much-recommended documentary earns the three full hours it demands of you. Weigh what it gives against what it takes; three hours is a real price, and only a film that repays it in full deserves your evening.

source: signed up for my first 10k, race day is march 15
target: Pehli 10k daud ke liye naam likha diya. Race 15 March ko hai. Ab peeche hatna mere bas ki baat nahi.
references: Pehli 10k daud ke liye naam likha diya. Race 15 March ko hai. Ab peeche hatna mere bas ki baat nahi.
titan_target: Your first ten kilometres, on the fifteenth of March. The distance will be run long before that morning, in all the ordinary ones. Race day only collects what the training has already decided.
